title: Schedule of Benefit Payment Terms — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)
content:
# Schedule of Benefit Payment Terms — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

This schedule sets out the terms on which Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) pays its benefits — the accelerated benefit to a terminally ill insured, and the death benefit to beneficiaries — together with the terms that govern beneficiary designations. Part A lists the accelerated benefit terms and Part B the death benefit and beneficiary terms, each for every coverage tier.

## Part A — Accelerated benefit

| Coverage tier | Largest share of the coverage payable early | Life expectancy at or below which it is available | How often it can be paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | 50 percent | 9 months | once per policy |

## Part B — Death benefit and beneficiaries

| Coverage tier | Ways a beneficiary may receive the death benefit | Number of monthly installments under the installment option | Overdue premium during grace deducted from the death benefit | Years after death within which a claim should be filed | New beneficiary designation takes effect | Designation must be signed by the insured |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | lump sum; 36 monthly installments | 36 | yes | 2 | on the date received | yes |

### Order of precedence where no valid beneficiary designation exists (all tiers)

1. spouse
2. children
3. parents
4. executor of the estate
5. next of kin

The claim-filing figure is the period after the insured's death within which a death claim should be filed before payment to an alternate is considered.

## Notes on reading the schedule

- Every figure in Parts A and B is the same on all six tiers; the tier changes the size of the coverage, never these terms.
- The 50 percent figure is a ceiling on the share of the coverage paid early, and 9 months is the life expectancy at or below which that early payment is available; a life expectancy of exactly 9 months is within it.
- The installment option pays the death benefit in 36 monthly installments; the only other way offered is a lump sum.
